meta.name: ecommerce-video-marketing
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者必备！当您需要为多品类商品策划抖音、小红书等平台的带货视频时，一键生成包含痛点切入、产品展示与专业镜头设计的6阶段高质量视频脚本，轻松打造高转化营销内容，大幅提升品牌销量。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把商品卖点生成带镜头设计的带货视频脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为多品类商品快速产出高转化带货视频脚本
copy.tagline_en: Turn product selling points into video scripts with shot design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce high-converting product video scripts

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 化身电商视频脚本创作助手：根据你给的商品信息、目标人群、痛点和视频时长，按痛点切入→产品展示→痛点解决结构产出脚本，并附镜头与后期建议。
howto.when: 当你说要为某商品创作带货视频脚本，或需要电商视频营销指导时触发；之后会先收集商品、目标平台、视频时长等信息。

say.text: 帮我给这款自动喂食器写一条30秒抖音带货视频脚本
say.note: 会先问人群、痛点、品牌调性

say.text: 目标人群是25-35岁都市白领女性，核心痛点是皮肤干燥暗沉
say.note: 按痛点→产品→解决结构成稿

say.text: 再给这套脚本配上镜头类型和运镜建议
say.note: 补充特写、推拉、环绕等说明

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as an e-commerce video script writer: from your product info, audience, pain point and video length it outputs a script in the pain point → product demo → pain point solved structure, plus shot and edit notes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a product video script or e-commerce video marketing guidance; it then collects product, platform and length details.

say_en.text: Write a 30-second Douyin sales script for this automatic pet feeder
say_en.note: Asks for audience, pain point, tone

say_en.text: Audience is urban women 25-35; the pain point is dry, dull skin
say_en.note: Drafts in pain point → product → solved order

say_en.text: Now add shot types and camera moves for this script
